baseline.reason: The supplied source-readiness-v2 directory is an extracted tree without .git; D:/1800 is not present in this environment.

archive_checker.cause: No Git repository and no root manifest.json in the extracted tree.

minimum_lossless_preservation_acceptance: Verify source byte length and SHA-256 before parsing.
Retain the exact original bytes or exact raw line bytes for all 19 records.
Retain record order, top-level field order, list order, exact strings, Unicode, whitespace, numeric types, empty strings, empty lists, nulls and missing-field distinctions.
Reject duplicate JSON keys before any last-wins object construction.
Retain every observed field including unknown future extra fields; a raw_record_hash without raw values is not lossless preservation.
Produce deterministic redacted error summaries with code, line and field identity but no business body excerpts.
Preservation success must not imply current completeness, platform identity, write eligibility or platform acceptance.
minimum_mapping_ledger_acceptance: Every source record is referenced by source file SHA-256 plus raw line SHA-256 and source order.
Canonical platform identity is null or UNBOUND unless copied from an authoritative same-state server response with evidence reference and membership binding.
tixu, DOM data-key, rectIndex, line number, visible label, content digest and content equality are observations only and cannot populate canonical platform_question_id.
Ambiguous, duplicate or conflicting candidates are explicit AMBIGUOUS or REJECTED states, never first-match selection.
No 19-versus-22 arithmetic is used to infer a denominator or three missing records.
The ledger defaults to write_allowed=false and cannot generate authority, activation, signature, receipt or save permission.

required_negative_cases.mutation: Use DOM data-key or rectIndex as canonical server ID
Use line number or record order as canonical identity
Use question text or content hash as canonical identity
Duplicate a JSON key in one source line
Drop or rename an unknown extra field
Collapse missing, null, empty string and empty list
Normalize whitespace, Unicode, list order or record order
Map one source row to multiple authoritative IDs
Map multiple source rows to one authoritative ID
Infer exactly three omissions from 19 historical records versus 22 visible labels
Set write_allowed true or emit authorization from preservation output
Accept wrong source SHA-256 or byte length
Silently keep the last value of a duplicate key
